title: Intravitreal Ranibizumab Injections Significantly Influence Retinal Venous Calibre in Patients With Diabetic Macular Oedema

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: open access under the terms of http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

condition: Treatment-naive centre-involving diabetic macular oedema; ranibizumab per the RESTORE protocol (three monthly loading injections, then PRN to 12 months); post hoc analysis of a prospective aqueous-cytokine study (DISCERN and later recruitment, Royal Victorian Eye and Ear Hospital, 2015-2021), 76 eyes of 67 patients; untreated fellow eyes analysed separately for vascular calibre only

groups.agent: intravitreal ranibizumab (dose not stated in this article), RESTORE protocol
groups.description: Treated study eyes (76 recruited); the number of eyes behind the Table 2 thickness values is not stated

exclusions.what: Table 2 CRAE, CRVE and AVR rows (R2-R4)
exclusions.reason: retinal vascular calibre, not retinal thickness

exclusions.what: Table 1 R10 baseline CMT of 'Included' and 'Excluded' eyes
exclusions.reason: baseline-only subsets defined by availability of gradable photographs; no follow-up thickness per subset
untreated fellow eyes are excluded and no thickness is tabulated for them

notes: Visual acuity, retinal vascular calibre and blood pressure are reported (not extracted).
Ambiguity resolved: the eye count behind the Table 2 CMT row cannot be established from the article, so n is recorded as null rather than inferred.

Ambiguity resolved: this article names neither the OCT device nor the CMT definition (the recruitment protocol is in its references 32-34); device unstated and measure central_unspecified; CMT taken as the OCT central macular thickness of the cited protocol.
Ambiguity resolved: the analysis set is restricted by the availability of gradable fundus photographs, not by a treatment outcome, so the series is kept.

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 2, CMT row, column 2), cited as the reference thickness
series.notes: mean ± SD (Table 2 footnote); changes are follow-up minus baseline in micrometres; scheduled visits at months 2 and 12 (eyes had received the month-0 and month-1 injections by month 2); number of eyes in Table 2 not stated and n left null: the Table 2 baseline means differ from those of the Table 1 'Included' set (complete baseline and month-2 photographs), and the Methods describe the primary analysis set as eyes with complete baseline and month-2 data; missing-visit handling for month 12 not stated
source_cells: definition:Table 2 footnote (change score = month 2/12 score minus baseline score; change at baseline is 0)
